description: Correction spans cut from decoded VAD chunks (ADR 0012). besedy/lib/correction_segmentation.py and web/src/lib/correction/segmentation.ts must both turn every case's transcript into its expected output; tests/test_correction_segmentation.py and web/tests/unit/correction-segmentation-contract.test.ts check that. Change all three together and bump the version when the output changes.

normalization.why: Leading, trailing and repeated spaces collapse.
Line breaks of every kind become one space.
No-break and zero-width spaces count as whitespace.
BOM and Mongolian vowel separator count as whitespace.
Ideographic space and line separator count as whitespace.
NEL and information separators stay: JavaScript does not treat them as whitespace.
NEL stays at the ends too: trimming removes only what JavaScript trims.
Text is composed to NFC (e + combining caron becomes one letter).

cases.name: single_region
cases.why: One region is one chunk and one span holding the whole segment text.

cases.name: chunk_packing
cases.why: Regions pack into one chunk while their speech totals at most 30 s; the fourth 10 s region starts a new chunk.

cases.name: split_at_one_second_gap
cases.why: Inside a chunk, a 0.5 s pause does not split and a pause of exactly 1 s does.

cases.name: long_pause_inside_chunk
cases.why: Speech on both sides of a 325 s pause shares one chunk but becomes two spans.

segments.text: Tady to končí. A tady začíná.

cases.name: split_long_run_prefers_parts_within_30s
cases.why: Of two wide pauses, the run over 30 s is cut at the one that leaves both parts within 30 s.

cases.name: split_long_run_at_widest_gap
cases.why: Pauses under 1 s never split, so a run over 30 s is split at its widest pause, recursively.

cases.name: split_long_run_equal_gaps_splits_evenly
cases.why: With all pauses equal, the run over 30 s is split into the most even parts instead of peeling off one region.

cases.name: merge_short_across_shorter_gap
cases.why: A 0.8 s span joins the neighbour across the shorter pause (1.5 s before, 3 s after).

segments.text: Tak jsme šli. A pak domů.

cases.name: merge_short_tie_prefers_previous
cases.why: With equal pauses on both sides, a short span joins the previous span.

cases.name: merge_short_refused_over_30s
cases.why: A short span stays alone when joining its only neighbour would pass 30 s.

cases.name: merge_short_falls_back_to_other_neighbour
cases.why: If the closer neighbour would pass 30 s, the short span joins the farther one.

cases.name: short_spans_merge_repeatedly
cases.why: Several short spans in a row merge until each is at least 2 s or cannot grow.

cases.name: word_in_removed_silence_goes_to_nearest_region
cases.why: A word whose midpoint lies in the pause between regions belongs to the nearest region.

cases.name: text_keeps_hyphen_spacing
cases.why: Span text is cut from the segment text, so 'ex-kidlo' keeps its spelling instead of the words joined by spaces.

cases.name: text_cut_at_first_word_of_each_span
cases.why: Leading punctuation goes with the first span; each later span starts at its first word.

cases.name: words_not_found_fall_back_to_joined_words
cases.why: When the words cannot be found in the segment text in order, each span gets its words joined by spaces.

cases.name: text_without_words_goes_to_first_span
cases.why: A segment with text but no words puts its text into the chunk's first span.

cases.name: empty_segment
cases.why: A segment with no text and no words gives spans with empty text.

cases.name: two_chunks_spans_never_cross
cases.why: Spans stay inside their chunk even when the pause between chunks is short.

cases.name: refuse_without_regions
cases.why: A source without clip_timestamps cannot be segmented, so correction must not start from it.

cases.name: refuse_chunk_mismatch
cases.why: A source whose regions rebuild into a different number of chunks than it has segments is refused.

cases.name: production_timing
cases.why: Region and word timing from the start of a production transcript, with placeholder words, to keep both ports exact on real floats.
